title: Works well for me
text:
Works well for me. Revised Review: Dropping from four stars to three.
After some time using this I have to agree that this ISN'T as good as the name brand. It works just OK, but you have to use more than the other stuff, so it won't last as long. It's still better than nothing considering my work-from-home station is very close to the bathroom door.
I don't get the bad reviews. This works just as well as more expensive brands. It's not overpowering and does the job. My only wish, and the reason for only 4 stars, is for the scent to be a bit stronger. However, I have a poor sense of smell, so for others it might be fine as is. I'll buy it again if it's still around when I need it next (this stuff lasts forever in a household of two).
